author: Turkey Tom
description:
Adrian Broner earned over 40 million dollars during his career as a pro-boxer. By April of 2026, he didn’t even have 10 dollars to uber home. Following a devastating loss to Marcos Maidana that shattered his ego, Adrian threw away his chance to reclaim his status in favor of an alternate reality. One where he began chewing through his money on first class flights, gambling losses, child support payments, and legal fees for his alleged crimes. It seemed like he was destined to remain a has-been - until he started streaming on Kick. It offered him an opportunity to reclaim his place in the culture, and get back some of the respect he lost - but with every passing day he only brings himself even lower. The man once considered the heir to Floyd Mayweather is now one of the internet's favorite laughing stocks - this is The Self Destruction of Adrien Broner. Hope you enjoy the vid.
